items.title: Is the 7-day trial really free?
items.description: Yes! You get full access to all premium features for 7 days. You can cancel anytime before the trial ends.

items.title: Can I learn other languages?
items.description: Currently, Lingua focuses exclusively on Spanish to ensure the highest quality conversational content.

items.title: What if I miss a day?
items.description: No worries! Our streak-repair feature helps you get back on track without losing your progress.

items.title: Is Lingua suitable for kids?
items.description: Lingua is designed for adult learners, focusing on real-world travel and professional scenarios.
